title: NBA Releases ₹15.52 Crore from Mustard Genetic Resources

blocks.content: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) released ₹15.52 crore in Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) proceeds from mustard genetic resources on 13 August 2026 under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002. The funds were collected from M/s Pioneer Overseas Corporation for the development of ten commercial hybrid varieties of mustard, or Brassica juncea.

items: Rajasthan received ₹6.43 crore, which was the largest share in the distribution.
Uttar Pradesh received ₹2.28 crore, Madhya Pradesh received ₹1.86 crore, Haryana received ₹1.21 crore, and West Bengal received ₹1.10 crore.
The NBA stated that its cumulative ABS releases reached ₹182.5 crore after this disbursement.
The NBA also stated that ₹116.22 crore had been distributed within the previous 12 months.
